question: What kinds of celestial beings may one become through this practice?
premises: One may become a divine maiden of the gods.
One may become a yaksha or vidyadhara.
inference: The practitioner may become a divine maiden of the gods or a yaksha-vidyadhara.
uncertainties: The compound yakṣa+vidyādharo may be read as a dual-type or alternative beings.
plain_english: He may become a divine maiden of the gods, or a yaksha or a vidyadhara.
